title: Add an optional note to todo items
goal: Clients can keep a short note with an item.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /todos and PATCH /todos/:id accept an optional note: a string of at most 500 characters, counted as characters (500 Chinese characters fit); a longer note or one that is not a string answers 400.
An item has a note field only when a note was given; PATCH with "note": null removes the field again.
